overall_summary: Data shows clear outliers in relationship and family emotional dynamics. Husband-wife dynamics and interpersonal communication friction heavily outperform abstract romantic shayaris, while family relationship themes maintain a steady baseline.

winning_patterns.pattern: Relatable marital and close relationship realities
winning_patterns.evidence: Wife emotional video (or5gtaBpRVY) gained 1,662 views, significantly outperforming all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more core videos on husband-wife and complex close relationship truths.

winning_patterns.pattern: Direct, relatable emotional statements in titles
winning_patterns.evidence: Titles addressing universal communication gaps ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala' - NO5fdHLxFL4) perform well above average (371 views).
winning_patterns.action: Use specific behavioral observations in hooks instead of generic heartbreak terms.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional video (fAAoIQCRMXU) received only 134 views after a previous low-performing iteration.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid recycling exact content angles that have already underperformed without a major narrative pivot.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic motivational or isolated philosophical topics
weak_patterns.evidence: Self motivation (JPf_3ebfnuk) underperformed at 171 views compared to targeted interpersonal relationship pieces.
weak_patterns.action: Ground all motivation strictly inside relationship or family contexts rather than standalone advice.
